additional_info.body:

Reboot and new converter gropping have been tried remote.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0444097-DC/Si-D/DK-[RVP / T5 170004755] Issue With power Convertors CRM:02699000175
additional_info.body:
Dear Martin,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0444097
for charger
3BR10j
. From what was reported in the ticket, the charger showed issues on the power converter grouping right after the commissioning.
I checked now the charger, triggering a reboot and few times the maintenance mode to check the grouping via debug station, and that is what I see:
In my eyes, the charger is stuck at REQUEST_CONVERTER_SERIALNUMBER phase, without finding any serial number. Since the charger has no communication at all with any converter, and not just few, I suspect an issue on the CAN line.
I would suggest to go onsite, and check XD14.1A and 1B:
and on the 120Ohm CAN termination.
Looking forward to hearing feedback from you!
With kind regards,
